note: Each frame row is [flux, onset (0/1), pulse, bpm, centroid] after that frame's Update.

cases.name: click_120bpm
cases.formula: every bin -30 dB on a hit frame, -75 dB otherwise; hits at frame % 30 == 0 for frames 0..899, then once at 900, then silence to 929

cases.name: steady
cases.formula: every bin -40 dB on every frame

cases.name: bass_only
cases.formula: -20 dB for i < bins/8, floor (-140) elsewhere

cases.name: treble_only
cases.formula: -20 dB for i > bins*7/8, floor (-140) elsewhere

cases.name: jittered_clock
cases.formula: dt = 0.020 when frame % 3 == 0 else 0.015; t = sum of the dts of all earlier frames (0 for the first); hit when (t % 0.5) < dt; bin i = hit ? -30 + (i % 5) : -75 + (i % 3)
